messages:
Maria: Kicking off the Armada interop / joint perf bench. Goal: compare perf/W and tail latency across our runtime vs VoltChip kernel tweaks. Need alignment on test matrix, telemetry, and public announcement cadence. @Lee can you confirm power telemetry availability?
Ajay: +1. Prefer to run end-to-end on 1) baseline BIOS, 2) thermal headroom enabled, 3) kernel patch v1 (sched + nvme tweak). Measure p95 latency, tokens/s, and watts.
Sam: Testbeds: 2 x c8g-prototypes (8xA100 equiv) and 1 small edge node. I can provision infra and an S3 bucket for results. What sample prompts & seq len?
Lee (VoltChip): We can expose per-socket PMU counters and board-level power rails via IPMI and our telemetry agent. BIOS knobs: turbo governor + memory interleave. We can ship kernel-patch build artifacts by Wed. Thermal headroom requires a config flip, might change peak throughput.
Maria: Great. Let's keep a minimal public story: "Throughput-per-watt uplift using VoltChip kernel tuning on Redwood runtime". We'll only draft joint announcement after we validate reproducible gains across 3 runs.
BenchBot: Automated schedule created: kickoff=1769001000, dry-run=1769001800, full-sweep=1769003000-1769004200. Results to s3://redwood-armada-bench/1769001000/
Sam: For prompts, propose two workloads: 1) long-context generation (seq=2048, batch=4) to stress KV cache; 2) short-chat (seq=128, batch=32) for throughput. We'll capture token/sec and p95.
Ajay: Add a microbenchmark with synthetic tokens to isolate kernel overhead: single-threaded latency and multi-thread throughput. Also collect stack traces for any >2x perf regression.
Lee (VoltChip): We'll provide a kernel build and a short tuning guide. Also can offer a hardware power clamp to simulate constrained datacenter.
Maria: Ops: ownership checklist — Sam owns infra + runs, Ajay owns measurement harness and analysis, Lee owns kernel builds & telemetry integration, Maria owns partner comms + announcement draft. Deadline: initial dry-run by EOD Thu (1769003000).
Sam: Quick example run command I'll use (dry-run):
```
./bench_runner --model redwood-3b --mode perf --seq 2048 --batch 4 --profile power --out s3://redwood-armada-bench/1769001000/run1.json
```
Sam: I'll also push the runner & graphs to the repo: github.com/redwood-inference/bench-scripts/tree/armada-kernel
Ajay: Telemetry format — prefer JSONL with fields [ts, host, cpu_power_w, board_power_w, tokens, latency_ms, kernel_version]. We'll merge traces by ts.
Lee (VoltChip): We can emit that format. We also want to collect kernel export of /sys/kernel/debug/sched for tuned runs.
Maria: OK set. Action items: Sam -> provision infra + run dry-run; Ajay -> measurement harness & parser; Lee -> kernel artifacts + telemetry hook; Maria -> announcement outline + legal check. Checkin tomorrow 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Ajay: Noted. I'll create a small eval set and share prompt seeds in the repo.
Lee (VoltChip): We'll upload kernel tarball to the S3 path once ready. Expect ETA 36h.
Sam: If anyone wants to see logs live I'll stream to #bench-ops. Otherwise I'll post summary & CSV to s3.
Maria: Perfect. If dry-run shows >10% perf/W uplift across both workloads we start drafting joint blog. If not, we'll iterate on kernel knobs. Thanks all. :rocket:
